name: TAFE NSW free counselling
summary: Free, confidential personal and career counselling for current TAFE NSW students.
key: TAFE NSW counselling and career development service is free and confidential.
who: Current TAFE NSW students; career counselling is also open to future students.
how: Call 131 601, choose option 5, then option 2 to make an appointment.

evidence.quote: TAFE NSW counselling and career development service is free and confidential.
If you’re a current student, you can book an appointment with a TAFE NSW counsellor.
